verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā divāvihāragato hoti paṭisallīno.
verses.english: Now at that time the Buddha had gone into retreat for the day’s meditation.

verses.pali: Atha kho sakko ca devānamindo brahmā ca sahampati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṁsu; upasaṅkamitvā paccekaṁ dvārabāhaṁ nissāya aṭṭhaṁsu.
verses.english: Then Sakka, lord of gods, and the divinity Sahampati approached the Buddha and stationed themselves one by each door-post.

verses.pali: Atha kho sakko devānamindo bhagavato santike imaṁ gāthaṁ abhāsi:
verses.english: Then Sakka spoke this verse in the Buddha’s presence:
“Rise, hero! Victor in battle, with burden put down,
wander the world free of debt.
like the moon on the fifteenth night.”
“Lord of gods, that’s not how to pay homage to the Realized Ones.
This is how it should be done:
‘Rise, hero! Victor in battle, caravan leader,
wander the world free of debt.
Let the Blessed One teach the Dhamma!
There will be those who understand!’”
